name: screen-flow-carousel
description: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

vars.description: How many screens ride the rail.
Comma-separated caption per screen. Blank entries use the authored defaults.
Comma-separated advance times in seconds from mount start. Blank entries use the authored even rhythm.
Token the active ring, caption dot, and skeleton accents ride.
Optional departure. Default none: the final screen holds until the cut.
